title: SWF: DefineButton2 tag (tag 34) encoding
description: Test that a Symbol with symbolType='button' produces DefineButton2 (tag 34) in exported SWF. Verify: (1) tag 34 appears for button symbols, (2) body has button type flags (IsTrackAsMenu bit), (3) button records for Up/Over/Down/Hit states are encoded, (4) button conditions (on release, on press etc.) appear in BUTTONCONDACTION records, (5) DefineSprite (tag 39) is NOT used for button symbols.
